authored_from: Written by hand from the HL7 v2.5.1 chapter 2 acknowledgement rules (MSH-15 and MSH-16 conditions AL/NE/ER/SU, MSA-1 commit codes CA/CE/CR and application codes AA/AE/AR) and from the declared receiver contract in docs/collect.md. No readmit command produced any expectation here.

cases.name: original mode under a v1 policy
cases.note: Original mode has one acknowledgement and it is the application stage.

cases.name: enhanced mode refused by a v1 policy
cases.note: A policy version that does not implement enhanced mode refuses the message by name rather than answering in a protocol it does not implement.

cases.name: both stages on the receiving connection
cases.note: The commit acknowledgement arrives first and reports only that the bytes were committed.

cases.name: accept stage only
cases.note: MSH-16 declares NE, so no application acknowledgement is sent and none may be recorded.

cases.name: undeclared acknowledgement condition
cases.note: MSH-15 carries a value that is not one of the four declared conditions. An unsupported mode is a named refusal, never a commit acceptance.

cases.name: application stage through a separate endpoint
cases.note: Not every enhanced acknowledgement uses one socket. The application stage arrives at the separately configured endpoint and nowhere else.
